messages:
maya: Quick sync — planning to enable model-v7 canary today. Need percent-based + region slices. Who can flip flags and watch metrics? thinking initial: EU 2%, NA 1% then ramp to 3%.

alex_w: I can flip EU slice, available ~14:00 PST. Toggle name: 'model-v7-canary'. Ping me when you want the change.

jiro: I will own NA ramp. prefer 1% -> 3% over 30m (gradual steps). add guardrail: if 5xx > 0.3% or error-rate delta > 0.2% rollback.

maya: sounds good. @ops-bot can you bump EU autoscaling min for the window so we don't OOM on burst?

ops-bot: scheduled autoscaling change: eu min_replicas=2 for 2026-03-17T22:00Z -> 2026-03-17T23:00Z. Reply 'ack' to confirm. (automated)

alex_w: ack

sam: added perf dashboard to the watch list: https://console.redwood.ai/metrics/model-v7 — set alerts on p95 (>600ms) and 5xx (>0.3%).

leo_s: dropped canary eval set at /evals/canary_v7. I'll run a passive eval batch after each ramp (50 checks).

deploy-bot: rollout job queued: roll/model-v7-canary by alex_w + jiro. JobID: r-20260317-881. ETA ~20m.

maya: plan: flip EU -> 2% now, monitor 15m, then flip NA -> 1% and ramp to 3% in steps. on-call: @jiro please escalate if 5xx > 0.3% or p95 > 600ms.

jiro: on it. also adding quick watcher: `watcher --api $MONITOR_KEY --metric 5xx_rate --threshold 0.3 --window 5m`

alex_w: flipped EU -> 2% (console: toggle 'model-v7-canary' -> slice eu=2%). :shipit:

maya: confirmed EU traffic ~1.9% on ingress. dashboard stable so far, proceeding to NA -> 1%.

jiro: NA at 1% now. scheduling ramp to 3% as +0.5% every 10m. (reacted :eyes: by team)

sam: FYI I linked the rollback runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/model-canary-rollback — includes steps to set percent=0 and notify on-call.

leo_s: eval run started (run/881/part-1). first batch shows a small uptick in hallucination score for assistant persona — logging details to /evals/logs/r-881.

maya: if quality regression > threshold (per eval config) -> rollback immediately. rollback command: `togglectl set model-v7-canary --percent 0` and @eng-oncall paging.

ops-bot: reminder: ensure KV cache warmup for v7: `infractl cache-warm --model model-v7 --regions eu,na`

jiro: warming KV cache now.

alex_w: NA ramp to 3% complete, no error signals or latency spikes observed in last 10m.

maya: great — leaving flags open for 48h. schedule follow-up sync for 2026-03-19. owners: @alex_w @jiro @leo_s. Thanks all! :tada:
